reasoning: All four answers agree with the earlier answers and their own captured Math Academy worked solutions. q-31991: x⁴−y⁶=(x²)²−(y³)², so the difference of squares gives (x²+y³)(x²−y³). q-113303: writing both fractions over g(2−h) gives (5g−3)/(g(2−h)), for g≠0 and h≠2. q-86327: cosine is the unit-circle x-coordinate, so cos(π/4)=√2/2. q-122083: selecting one attraction gives 5+7+3=15 choices.
